title: App Statistic keeps downloads anonymous, preserves install linkage and filtered server totals
steps: Run PostgreSQL list/detail and download tracking tests against an isolated schema on the PR branch.
Verify admission, aggregate paging, attribution provenance, retry exclusion and stable install identity.
expect: Only accepted staff seats can read list and detail; anonymous records never expose another account history.
Download GET requests are deduplicated within the recorded retry window; HEAD, range and update ZIP requests do not count, and recorder failures do not block download.
Public header/query claims never assign account or install ownership to sessionless downloads.

Server totals remain consistent with filters and pages beyond 500 installs; downloads never enrich account aggregates, version updates retain the same install and resolved issues no longer count as attention.
Account acquisition and legacy activity use verified account ownership, without assigning a source to anonymous downloads or installs.
fence: Tests use isolated local PostgreSQL fixtures and the real application/router; no production user data or guessed attribution.

tests: rejects malformed filters instead of broadening the requested scope
users aggregate real account-linked app copies; anonymous downloads never enrich people
pagination exceeds 500, remains stable, and preserves totals on an empty page
rolling date, unknown identity, literal search and account filters match their counts
anonymous detail never groups other anonymous records; sign-in linkage identifies one install
needs attention excludes resolved history and restores manually reopened issues
both list and detail require an accepted Tracy admin workspace seat
account source is attribution of first sign-in, not assigned to anonymous downloads or installs
full application serves the installed list and detail routes behind the same staff boundary
detail reports truncated account histories and version search matches users and installs
legacy email-only account events appear without stealing events assigned to another account
artifact metadata uses the served release path and permits unknown flat-name fields
retry token expires after a fixed 15 minutes, rejecting malformed and future tokens
installer GET sets a private short-lived retry cookie and leaves ZIP caching untouched
HEAD, range requests, ZIPs, failed storage responses and partial responses are not counted
tracking failure or a stalled recorder cannot prevent the installer response
one artifact/token pair writes once, another artifact or token counts separately
direct requests never trust account/install claims; source is sanitized, version uses the path
route plus database preserves retry dedupe and leaves install/user counts unchanged
the real app wires installer tracking before session middleware without inferring identity
